newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Heavy C.Amorim trade a portfolio switch.
newsitem.headline: Heavy C.Amorim trade a portfolio switch.

text.p: A trade equal to 52.4 percent of the capital of cork maker Corticeira Amorim-SGPS was motivated by a switching of stakes within the Amorim group, the vice-president of Amorim Investimentos, Jorge Armindo, told Reuters.
"It is an internal reorganisation. We are reorganising the group's sub-holdings by areas and business. We have created a new company called Amorim Capital for the (Corticeira) stake," he said.
Corticeira Amorim has quoted capital of 14.3 billion escudos ($91 million). On Friday, 7.5 million shares were traded in the company.
Referring to the company's prospects, Armindo said that the group had not expected strong growth in 1996 but it hoped that 1997 would be much better.
The company has forecast net profits could grow by up to five percent this year from 1.4 billion escudos in 1995.
